summary.finding: Twenty-five identities have two genuinely independent frozen lineages proving watchOS, exact version, publicBeta channel, displayed public-program ordinal, and America/Los_Angeles date. Thirty identities remain blocked: 21 packet-supportable rows fail the strict gate and all nine preblocked rows remain unresolved. Five scoped parents have no approved appearance and remain applicable/no-positive/reversible, never historical absence.

reasonCodeDefinitions.APPROVED_EXACT_TWO_LINEAGES: Two genuinely independent publisher families prove every required identity field at claim level.
reasonCodeDefinitions.BLOCK_EXACT_PUBLIC_ORDINAL_MISSING: No qualifying frozen full capture displays the required public-program ordinal and candidate date.
reasonCodeDefinitions.BLOCK_SECOND_INDEPENDENT_EXACT_LINEAGE_M: Only one genuinely independent exact lineage proves the candidate identity.
reasonCodeDefinitions.BLOCK_UNRESOLVED_ORDINAL_OR_DATE_CONFLIC: Frozen evidence conflicts on the public ordinal or America/Los_Angeles date.
reasonCodeDefinitions.EXCLUDE_DEVELOPER_ORDINAL_OR_GENERIC_PUB: A developer/generic beta number plus public availability does not display a separate public-program ordinal.
reasonCodeDefinitions.EXCLUDE_SEARCH_INDEX_ONLY_AFTER_522: A bounded search-index extract after HTTP 522 is provenance only unless independently corroborated by exact full-page evidence.
reasonCodeDefinitions.EXCLUDE_DERIVATIVE_LINEAGE: An article explicitly attributed to the paired publisher cannot count as an independent second lineage.
reasonCodeDefinitions.EXCLUDE_EXACT_PACIFIC_DATE_CONFLICT: The source displays or normalizes to a different America/Los_Angeles date.
reasonCodeDefinitions.AUDITED_NO_POSITIVE_BUT_REVERSIBLE: No exact positive identity passed this audit; the result is reversible and is not proof of historical absence.
reasonCodeDefinitions.UNRECORDED_DATE_CONFLICT: Frozen sources disagree on the date, but the packet did not include the disagreement in conflicts.json.
